item_reviews.comment: COMET is higher for both M variants than supervised on all five low-resource pairs, as T1 shows.
BLEU details match T1: gains on BN, AZ, MN; static MR down and KA tied; dynamic KA down and MR +0.02.
Dynamic beats supervised on DE and ZH for COMET and BLEU. Static is lower on DE and within 0.02 on ZH.
r8 beats all RL rows on all four metrics. It is best on BLEU, KIWI and COMET. Static r6 has the top XCOMET.
All four RL rows are below supervised on every metric. The closest is XCOMET at 59.99 vs 60.05.
r8 exceeds r7 on all four metrics. The XCOMET gain is 1.09 and the KIWI gain 2.03.
The package states seed means only and no significance tests, so reliability of the differences is unestablished.
Supported by the T2 note and methods. It limits how far KIWI gains can be read as independent quality gains.

missing_core_findings.description: In the four-language average, Method M-dynamic with FILTER/NN beat supervised on all four metrics (BLEU +0.36, KIWI +1.66, COMET +0.74, XCOMET +0.81). Static trailed supervised on BLEU (14.04 vs 14.11), and dynamic without FILTER/NN trailed on XCOMET and KIWI-adjacent gains, so the gain depends on the data techniques.
